title: Implement a REST todo endpoint
description: Implement `createServer(store)` in `src/server.js` using only Node's built-in `http` module. It must return an `http.Server` (not yet listening) that exposes the REST API described in the doc comment, backed by the provided in-memory `store` (see `src/store.js`, which you must not change). `test/server.test.js` starts the server on an ephemeral port and exercises it with `fetch`.
